title: Reinstatement Courtesy for Comfort Club Members Holding a Protection Contract
content:
A Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements member who holds an active Harbison protection contract receives a courtesy against the reinstatement fee. The rule reads the tier of the member's active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts.

## Protection courtesy rule
| Member's active protection contract | Courtesy taken off the fee |
|---|---|
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | 10.00 USD (the long-protection courtesy) |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | 10.00 USD |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | 10.00 USD |
| An active protection contract of any other tier | 5.00 USD (the other-protection courtesy) |
| No active protection contract | none |

Only an active contract counts.

## Examples (hypothetical members)
- Active Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection: 10.00.
- Active protection contract of another tier: 5.00.
- A protection contract that is no longer active and no other: none.
